entities.summary: Colonel Oli Ahmad is a Bangladeshi politician. He is a former minister and a member of the Jatiya Sangsad. He is a former Bangladesh Army officer. He is a former Bangladesh Nationalist Party politician and currently president of the Liberal Democratic Party of Bangladesh.
